text:
jules: Security is scheduling a deny-by-default keystore ACL in eu-west-2 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. They call out privatelink endpoints — possible onboarding impact.
sec-bot: Change scheduled by @security: keystore-acl-deny-euw2 at 2024-11-20T02:00Z. CHG-20241120-214.
karim: Warmpool and spot-onboard CIDRs (10.24.8.0/22, 10.24.12.0/24) talk to keystore via privatelink, so likely in-scope.
maya: If blocked we'll get `keystore:403` on handshake and join retries. Prior incident added ~25% warmup time.
jules: Proposed quick mitigations: 1) short-lived TF allowlist with TTL tag, 2) 2-node canary run, 3) faster readiness fail (3 attempts).
karim: +1. Make allowlist a tf toggle so rollback is trivial. Suggest TTL 3h.
maya: I'll open branch `tmp/keystore-euw2-allowlist` and include allowlist_ttl="3h". Will also add cloudwatch alarm: keystore_5xx > 3% for 5m.
cost-ops: FYI cost hit estimate 6-9% for the AZ during the window. We'll auto-pause bulk warmups if warmup latency > baseline +25%.
jules: Canary runbook: apply allowlist -> spin 2 canary nodes -> run handshake test `curl -H "X-Node:canary" https://keystore-proxy.internal/handshake` -> monitor 15m -> rollback if errors.
karim: Preflight scheduled 01:30 UTC. I'll tail `gpu-join` logs: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=gpu-join --since=30m`.
maya: Readiness probe PR ready, will mark NotReady after 3 failed handshakes.
jules: I'll coordinate with security. Be on standby 01:15-02:15 UTC. If canary fails we ask security to exempt onboarding CIDRs or we rollback ACL.
sec-bot: Temporary channel created: #temp/keystore-euw2-acl-preflight (auto).
jules: Thanks team — we'll debrief post-change and decide on a permanent keystore peering for onboarding traffic.
